description: Passes a trigger through to one output or the other according to two tests made on two signals, which are usually LFOs

params.text: Chooses what is tested on the lfo1 input: dir tests which way that signal moved between this sample and the last, sign tests whether it is above or below 0V
Chooses what is tested on the lfo2 input: dir tests which way that signal moved between this sample and the last, sign tests whether it is above or below 0V
Sets what the lfo1 test has to find for that side to pass: plus for rising or positive, minus for falling or negative, zero for no change at all or exactly 0V
Sets what the lfo2 test has to find for that side to pass: plus for rising or positive, minus for falling or negative, zero for no change at all or exactly 0V
Chooses whether both sides have to pass before a trigger reaches the trig output, or only one of them

inputs.text: The trigger to be passed or blocked; whatever voltage is here appears unchanged at whichever of the two outputs the tests send it to
The first of the two signals tested
The second of the two signals tested

outputs.text: Carries the voltage at the trig input while the tests pass, and 0V while they do not
Carries the voltage at the trig input while the tests do not pass, and 0V while they do, so between them the two outputs let every trigger through somewhere

notes: with dir selected, the zero setting is almost never matched, because a moving signal changes by some amount at every sample; it matches an unpatched jack, which never changes at all
the two switches and the two small knobs are read once every four samples, while the trigger and the two signals are read every sample

inputs.0:
stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
bipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
